mentions.name: Three Kind Words
mentions.description: A web service where people anonymously send a friend three physical postcards, one word at a time; the first two cards are unsigned and the last one reveals who sent them, arriving as a slow, kind surprise in the mail. The whole sending process is automated and costs almost nothing to run, with 246 of the 300 postcards targeted for the year delivered so far.
mentions.audience: People who want to send a friend a slow, kind anonymous surprise in the mail
mentions.source_excerpt:
Three Kind Words (https://threekindwords.com)

It’s a small vending machine on the internet where people anonymously send a friend three postcards, one word at a time. The first two cards are unsigned, and the last one reveals who sent them. It’s meant to be a slow, kind surprise in the mail.
